verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt containing agent-directed instructions. Terminal docs are served as markdown, with docs.stripe.com/terminal.md returning HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed at them directly. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt indexes Terminal-specific pages (the probe content is truncated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.stripe.com/llms.txt # Stripe Documentation
